Instant Money Transfer Alternatives to PayPal for Urgent Transactions: Seeking Recommendations
Are there any alternatives to PayPal that allow for instant sending and receiving of money immediately after signing up? I tried using Payoneer and Wise, but they required an account review and a waiting period before allowing me to send money. My client needs to send money today, but PayPal is not working for them. Could you please recommend other apps that allow for instant sending and receiving of money after signing up?
